title: Privacy notices are no longer boilerplate: What every organisation should get right under India's DPDP regime
description: In this Leading Questions piece, Dhruv Kaushal explains how under India's DPDP Act, privacy notices must be clear, specific and regularly updated, reflecting actual data practices, using plain language, and functioning as dynamic tools to ensure transparency, informed consent, and accountability.Question: The DPDP Act has elevated the importance of privacy notices. How does the current regime differ from the traditional approach of publishing a generic privacy policy on a website?Answer: The DPD
